He's been shaking them since he was two years old.|Allies|AoC}} Hestu's Maracas go unnamed in {{TotK}}. ==Location and Uses== ==={{BotW|-}}=== Hestu's Maracas are [[Key Item]]s belonging to [[Hestu]]. When [[Link]] first speaks to Hestu, he explains that a band of [[Bokoblin]]s stole his Maracas from him,{{Cite|Those monsters over there stole my beloved {{Color BotW|Red|maracas}}!|Hestu|BotW}}{{Cite|I think they're still there on the other side of those rocks.|Hestu|BotW}} and pleads for Link to help him retrieve them.{{Cite|I can't use my {{Color BotW|Blue|powers}} without them. {{Small|Shoko...}} So please! PLEASE get my {{Color BotW|Red|maracas}} back from them!|Hestu|BotW}} This initiates the [[Side Quest]], "[[The Priceless Maracas]]". Hestu's Maracas are hidden in a [[Treasure Chest]] behind a rock archway along the road south of [[Kakariko Village]]. In order to open the Chest, Link must slay the Bokoblins guarding it. Upon Link returning to Hestu with the Maracas, Hestu will recognize them and request that Link return them to him.{{Cite|{{Big|SHALA-KALA! Those are...}} Those are my {{Color BotW|Red|maracas}}! Please giiiiiive them to meeeeeeeee!|Hestu|BotW}} However, Hestu realizes that the [[Korok Seed]]s inside his Maracas are missing, and begrudges the fact that without them he cannot help to expand Link's [[Inventory]].{{Cite|♪SHAAAAAA-LAAAAAH-KAAAAAAH!♪ But wait! There's something wrong with my maracas! The {{Color BotW|Red|Korok seeds}} inside are gone! How am I supposed to dance now? Shoko... If I had just {{Color BotW|Red|one Korok seed}}, I could sing, dance, and use my {{Color BotW|Blue|powers}} to help you. You see, I have the power of {{Color BotW|Blue|inventory}} expansion! So let me know if you find some {{Color BotW|Red|Korok seeds}}!|Hestu|BotW}} Hestu reasons that the Korok Seeds must have been removed as a prank from his fellow [[Korok]]s and begs Link to retrieve his Seeds in return for expanding the [[Hylian]] [[Champion]]'s Inventory.{{Cite|The children of the forest must have taken the {{Color BotW|Red|Korok seeds}} from my beloved maracas. I never thought I'd be the target of one of their pranks. Shoko... *sniff* But wait... *sniff sniff* Do you have a {{Color BotW|Red|Korok seed}}?! You do! You got a {{Color BotW|Red|Korok seed}} from one of the forest children! If you'll give me just {{Color BotW|Red|one Korok seed}}, I'll make your {{Color BotW|Blue|inventory}} bigger in return!|Hestu|BotW}} There are a total of 900 Korok Seeds that Hestu needs to fill his Maracas, though Hestu can only use 441 of them to channel his Inventory-expansion powers through his Maracas. According to their description, Hestu has owned his Maracas since he was two years old. ==={{TotK|-}}=== {{Stub|TotK}} At the beginning of {{TotK}}, [[Hestu]] is already is possession of his Maracas. ==Other Appearances== ==={{AoC|-}}=== {{Noncanon|Start}} Hestu's Maracas appear as Hestu's Tier 1 weapons, and are immediately wielded by him during the events of the [[Scenario]] "[[Freeing Korok Forest]]", where he both is first made playable and is recruited following the completion of the Scenario. Hestu's fighting style revolves around not only beating monsters and the like with the Maracas, but summoning Koroks to his aid with them. As the Maracas are the default tier of weapons Hestu can use, they will later be outclassed by the [[Shaka Maracas]], which serve as Hestu's Tier 2 weapons, and [[Shakalaka Maracas]], Hestu's Tier 3 weapons. Hestu's Maracas also primarily serve as the icons for the Battle Support-type [[Side Quests]] pertaining to increasing inventory capacity, though one ("A Most Peculiar Korok") allows the ability to see the amount of hidden Korok Seeds there are in all Story Chapter battles and certain Challenge Scenario battles from within the Battle Info screen. {{Noncanon|End}} ==Nomenclature== {{Nomenclature}} ==Gallery== {{All Images}} File:AoC Maracas Icon.png|{{Game Label|{{AoC|-}}}}Icon for Hestu's Maracas ==See Also== {{See Also| * Hestu's Gift * Korok Seed }} {{Ref}} {{Categories |Musical Instruments, Percussion Instruments, Weapons |items= BotW, AoC |key-items= BotW |objects= TotK }}
